تستحضرن (form X)
# تَسْتَحْضِرْنَ (tastaḥḍirna) /tas.taħ.dˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
# تُسْتَحْضَرْنَ (tustaḥḍarna) /tus.taħ.dˤar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
